where.sr1: The Shrine is next to where you wake. Press {use} at it.
where.gw1: Press {use} at the Shrine and choose YOUR SPIRIT GARDEN.
where.gw2: The seed is in the shed by the gate. Carry it into open sky and let go.
where.gw3: The slab is at the plate shrine on the Athanor. A launch lotus flies you there.
where.fk1: Mistress Saggar is on the workshop floor, by the kiln.
where.sk12: The atrium rail, upstairs in the workshop, is a vantage point.
where.br1: Pots are all over the workshop. Press {use} to pick one up and {primary} to throw it.
where.tc1: A chest is in the basement's hub. Drop through the hole in the workshop floor.
where.pl6: Use the Index in the basement's hub and choose the Dunes.
where.jl1: Slip jellies are on the sand past the Weir.
where.sf1: On the Dunes, press {skiff} to call the Solar Skiff.
where.an1: Go to the Weir's pier. Open the Pneuka Box ({box}), set the Sondelass as Main, draw it ({draw}) and switch to the rod.
where.cx3: The course circles the basement's hub. Pass all eight stations.
